scope: C16 fixed-work token diagnostic only. Sixteen requests with 4096 input and 256 output tokens. This profile is independent of the 32K profile; their resource and context differences must not be merged into one strict comparison. The C16 capacity floor of 69632 is workload evidence, never a generic planner constant.

numeric.weights: Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 target and MTP draft artifacts; record any reference re-quantization instead of hiding it
numeric.activation: native BF16 bulk attention with canonical F32 through the first 2048 prompt positions; record reference BF16 rules separately
numeric.kv: FP8 E4M3 target KV with F32 recurrent state; capacity work must not silently reduce precision

quality.gate: original 1024-case scorer with overall, zero-shot and eight-shot one-sided CP95 gross regression below 2 percent

resources.note: Both engines receive the same share and 4352-token ceiling with vision available. The reference per-step cap is 2048 while native derives its own cap; this is a declared implementation difference, not an equal-prefill claim. Actual byte budgets and funded KV must be reported; failed startup produces no throughput.
